checks.name: All eight catalogs have matching active keys and placeholder contracts
Fresh and invalid storage default to Chinese
Blocked local storage does not prevent switching
Stored choice survives initialization and invalid choices are rejected
Chinese whitespace and user text remain exact
Known UI, accessible labels and computed text translate
Full numeric messages translate before label fragments
Language-specific cache cannot leak between languages
Missing text falls back and is recorded, not blanked
Localized search includes both original and translated title
Offline and deployed bundles embed the same language resources
Numeric and date formatting use the chosen locale
Exports localize headings while keeping user content and line breaks
Every supported locale can be saved and restored
Local font files match the deployment and carry license records
Offline fonts are embedded and deployment uses local URLs
